whats.Confluent CTO: AI agents expose a data t: AI tools can only act on the data they receive, so slow or late data can lead to weaker decisions. Ask your team how fresh your data is.
whats.Meta postpones revised business terms as: How AI uses published content is still being argued over. If your team creates or shares content, watch how these rules develop.
whats.India can export digital infrastructure,: India's AI skills and digital systems are seen as a strength, but growth faces hurdles. Managers should think about where those skills can help their business.
whats.Reddit's massive developer community r/o: Some online communities are setting firm rules on AI. Check the rules of any group or platform before you share AI-made work there.
whats.India Data Centres Gain Global AI Demand: Demand for AI is lifting interest in Indian data centres, but power delays are a worry. This can affect the cost and speed of AI services you buy.

term.def: Guardrails are rules and checks built around an AI tool to stop it from doing things it should not, like sharing private data or acting without approval.

prompt.prompt: Act as an AI risk advisor. I manage [team] and want staff to use AI for [task]. List five simple guardrails we should set, with one real example of each in plain words.

quiz.q: If you write a clear, detailed request, an AI tool will always give you a correct answer.
quiz.why: A good request helps, but AI can still give wrong answers in a confident tone. Always check important facts before you use them.

quiz.q: Livemint reports that Indian IT companies see business in policing AI agents.
quiz.why: This is what the headline says. Checking and controlling AI tools is becoming a service that companies may pay for.

quiz.q: An AI chatbot understands your question the way a person does.
quiz.why: It predicts likely words from patterns in the data it learned from. It can sound sure even when it has no real grasp of your situation.

quiz.q: India Today reports that Reddit's r/opensource community has banned all AI projects.
quiz.why: This is what the headline says. Online communities set their own rules on AI, so it is wise to read those rules before you post.

quiz.q: An AI system fed poor or outdated data will usually give poor or outdated results.
quiz.why: AI output depends heavily on the data behind it. Clean, current and well-organised data is one of the best ways to get useful answers.
